notes: Wan 2.2 14B image-to-video (high + low noise experts, fp8) with the lightx2v 4-step LoRAs on: real motion and camera moves from a still (orbit, crane, push-in, tracking) in a few minutes. 832x480 (or 480x832) at 16 fps, `seconds` long (length = seconds*fps+1). `lightning` false runs the full 20-step / cfg 3.5 schedule instead (better detail, ~5x slower). Converted from the official video_wan2_2_14B_i2v.json template through the real 0.37 frontend (graphToPrompt).
